title: Review export controls sanctions and cross-border shipments
summary: Before supplying goods, software, technology or services across borders with unresolved trade restrictions. A documented clearance or stop decision and, where permitted, a reconciled shipment or delivery record.
outcomes: A documented clearance or stop decision and, where permitted, a reconciled shipment or delivery record.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before supplying goods, software, technology or services across borders with unresolved trade restrictions.

parts.title: Collect the transaction and product facts
parts.guidance: Identify the parties, ownership, destinations, transit routes, end user, end use and goods or technology supplied. Include software, technical access and services where relevant rather than treating shipment as a parcel-only question.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Obtain a trade-compliance assessment
parts.guidance: Qualified specialists determine classification, applicable export and import controls, sanctions, licenses and screening requirements. Record the current sources and assumptions and pause transactions with unresolved restrictions.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Prepare the authorized documentation and logistics plan
parts.guidance: Assemble the approved licenses, commercial invoice, origin, customs and transport information. Clarify responsibility for duties, insurance, delivery and recordkeeping with the broker and counterparty.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Authorize the specific delivery
parts.guidance: The accountable reviewer confirms screening, approvals, quantities and destination still match the assessed transaction. Authorized operators release the shipment or technical access only within the approved scope.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Reconcile delivery and continuing conditions
parts.guidance: Match customs, transport, receipt and payment evidence to the approved transaction. Track license conditions, returns or changed end-use information and retain the records under the applicable schedule.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: A documented clearance or stop decision and, where permitted, a reconciled shipment or delivery record.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
